name: A · Salsa brass montuno
description: Trumpet plays a tight syncopated riff while trombone answers — classic Nuyorican salsa call-and-response.

roles.name: Tambora
roles.groove: mask "<f!4 t!12>" $ s "[woodblock_vcsl:6 ~ woodblock_vcsl:6 woodblock_vcsl:7] [woodblock_vcsl:6 ~ congas:22 ~] [woodblock_vcsl:6 ~ woodblock_vcsl:6 woodblock_vcsl:7] [congas:6 ~ congas:22 congas:22]" # gain 0.9 # room 0.15

literal.name: Tambora
literal.code: mask "<f!4 t!12>" $ s "[woodblock_vcsl:6 ~ woodblock_vcsl:6 woodblock_vcsl:7] [woodblock_vcsl:6 ~ congas:22 ~] [woodblock_vcsl:6 ~ woodblock_vcsl:6 woodblock_vcsl:7] [congas:6 ~ congas:22 congas:22]" # gain 0.9 # room 0.15

literal.name: Piano
literal.code: mask "<t!12 f!2 t!2>" $ n "<[g4 [c5 e5] g4 [c5 e5] g4 c5 e5 [g5 e5]] [a4 [c5 f5] a4 [c5 f5] a4 c5 f5 [a5 f5]] [g4 [b4 f5] g4 [b4 f5] g4 b4 d5 [f5 d5]] [g4 [c5 e5] g4 [c5 e5] g4 c5 e5 [g5 e5]]>" # s "bright_acoustic_piano_fluid" # legato 0.6 # gain "[0.9 0.75]*4" # room 0.2

literal.name: Trumpets
literal.code: mask "<t!4 f!4 t!4 f!2 t!2>" $ n "<[g5 e6 ~ g6 e6 g5 e5 ~] ~ [a5 f6 ~ a6 f6 a5 f5 ~] ~>" # s "trumpet_fluid" # legato 0.75 # gain 0.9 # room 0.2

literal.name: Trombone response
literal.code: mask "<f!8 t!4 f!2 t!2>" $ n "<~ [c5 ~ g5 e5 ~ c5 ~] ~ [f5 ~ c5 a4 ~ f4 ~]>" # s "trombone_fluid" # legato 0.85 # gain 0.85 # room 0.2 # pan (-0.3)
